notes.title: Qasir al-Wasat is coming January 19 2016
notes.content:
This week we would like to hand you a special letter, delivered in a blue velvet envelope, and containing distinguished news:
The game will be available for PC, Mac and Linux in about one month!

Watch the teaser now:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MAVjuOhDWkA
And you can now check our gorgeous new website: qasirgame.com
